display_name: Billing Narrative & Time-Entry Drafter for Law Firms
description: One skill: /billing-narrative. Paste rough notes, an email thread, or calendar event details; the skill drafts a clean, billing-code-appropriate time-entry narrative with a suggested time increment. Attorney reviews and edits before pasting into Clio, MyCase, PracticePanther, or the Legal Billing Tracker. Assisted draft, always reviewed — never submits anything automatically.
